chapter: World's Greatest Jazz Band and Denver
title: Leaving the band after moving to Denver
summary: Gus left because the band wouldn't fly him in for gigs and used others.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: And then when I left the band, I left because I'd moved out here. Well, they wouldn't send for me to do a gig in New York, staying or the state or something like that.
And Dick would. He would -- because I was the drummer in the band, see. Instead, they got Bobby ten Rosengard and -- to make the short gigs, and when they'd come
out here, they'd want me to play, see. But I wouldn't do it like that.
Either I'm with the band or I'm not, see.
Either be a part of it or not.
